scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm test:boundaries && pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:rust: pnpm build:frontend && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features fake-platform,test-harness -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features x11-capture -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins --all-features -- -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && vue-tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm fixtures:generate:m01 && vitest run --project core --project renderer --project vue --project fixtures --project fake-platform
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm fixtures:generate:m01 && vitest run --coverage --project core --project renderer --project vue --project fixtures --project fake-platform
scripts.test:render:update: pnpm fixtures:generate:m01 && CUTE_SCREEN_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 vitest run --project render-harness
scripts.smoke:m01:x11: cargo run --features platform-smoke,x11-capture --bin m01-platform-smoke -- x11-controlled --output artifacts/m01/x11-controlled.json
scripts.smoke:m01:portal:probe: cargo run --features platform-smoke --bin m01-platform-smoke -- portal-probe --output artifacts/m01/portal-probe.json
scripts.smoke:m01:portal:screenshot: cargo run --features platform-smoke --bin m01-platform-smoke -- portal-screenshot --output artifacts/m01/portal-screenshot.json
scripts.smoke:m01:portal:shortcuts: cargo run --features platform-smoke --bin m01-platform-smoke -- portal-shortcuts --output artifacts/m01/portal-shortcuts.json
scripts.smoke:m01:portal:invalid-uri: cargo run --features platform-smoke --bin m01-platform-smoke -- portal-invalid-uri --output artifacts/m01/portal-invalid-uri.json
